metadata.description: siteseo audits sites you own for search and AI search readiness. It runs against a local build directory or a live URL, keeps search health and AI access as two separate scores, and gates deploys with no model calls and no paid API calls.

plugins.name: siteseo
plugins.description: Search and AI search readiness auditing for sites you own. Local build or live URL, evidence behind every finding, two scores that are never blended, first-party Search Console and Bing history committed to the site repo, AI citation tracking, diff-gated fixes to source templates, and a free pre-deploy gate.
